type.description: Authored classification. This single field spans both ontology axes for backward compatibility: for a flat document it names the semantic ROLE (the kind of truth it carries); for an entity layer or a decision it names the structural FORM. Use 'entity-layer' for docs under .knowledge/entities/<id>/ and set `layer` for the specific layer; use 'governance-decision' for docs under .knowledge/governance/decisions/. The builder derives separate canonical `form` and `role` fields from this plus location - see templates/schemas/knowledge-ontology.json. An explicit value here outranks path inference, so a navigational README beside a set of decisions may declare it is not one.

layer.description: Entity-layer classification for docs under .knowledge/entities/<id>/. Optional — absent for non-entity knowledge (governance, reference).

path.description: Repository-relative regular file; never a directory or planning/archive path.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the claim's canonical comparison bytes.

baseline.description: Content-addressed immutable baseline path; must be derivable from `digest`.

profile.description: Versioned comparison profile, e.g. python-token-v1, exact-text-v1, binary-v1.

region.description: Optional symbolic region name resolved by the selected profile.

source_of_truth.description: Repo-relative paths (legacy strings, unchanged existing semantics) or additive object claims {path, digest, baseline, profile, region} this doc describes. Each must exist; required whenever `layer` is set. The tuple (path, profile, region) must be unique within the document; enforced by the generator, not this schema.

state.description: Applies to the document and all its object source claims. Migration and scaffolding may write only pinned-unverified; only a confirmed explain workflow may set verified.

confirmed_on.description: Required only for state: verified; prohibited for pinned-unverified.

last_verified.description: Date this doc was last confirmed to match source_of_truth. Required whenever `layer` is set.

aliases.description: Optional discovery-only search vocabulary: common developer phrasing that should reach this document. Aliases never alter taxonomy, identity, or ontology relationships, and are never a source of authoritative behavioral truth.

constrains.description: Required for type 'governance-decision': the entity ids this decision constrains. Each entity must carry a reciprocal `constrained_by` pointer.
